voice.name: James - Relaxed American Voice
voice.why: The power plant's yard clerk weighs coal all shift and has stopped being impressed by anyone: unhurried, plain, a little dry. James is a relaxed middle-aged American with a casual register, lighter than the sawmill foreman's resonance, the trickster buyer's husk or the mine foreman's baritone, and no other speaker uses this voice.

greet.text: Coal yard. Put your lumps on the counter and I pay cash for every one. The plant burns what it burns.

how.text: My purse only goes so deep. When it runs dry I will say so, and you come back in an hour. It fills again.

bye.text: Mind the Ural on your way out.
